title: Agentic AI Engineer - AI and Data Science Engineer II
description:
**GenAI / Agentic AI Engineer, Consultant**

**Deloitte Consulting LLP | IDT**

**About the Role**

As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high-quality work products within due timelines. On a need basis, you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members and liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements. This role is based out of Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Kolkata, Chennai, or Pune.

IDT anticipates how technology will shape the future and begin building future capabilities and practices today, driving the ideation, incubation, and scale of hybrid businesses and tech-enabled offerings. Partnering with the broader network — including Converge, Smart Factory, TrueServe, and Cortex AI — IDT brings together dreamers, designers, and builders to deliver a unique point of view and future-proof both Deloitte's business and its clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Build & Deploy Agentic Solutions**

* Design, develop, and deploy modules in agent-based platforms, adhering to Deloitte and industry best practices
* Build proofs-of-concept and prototypes leveraging commercial or open-source agent orchestration frameworks

**Agent Platform Engineering**

* Support the setup and operationalization of Multi-Agent Control Platform (MCP) servers, collaborating under the direction of senior team members
* Contribute to the development and refinement of agent communication flows, including state and memory management
* Integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Context Augmented Generation (CAG) capabilities in alignment with solution architectures

**Collaborate & Grow**

* Collaborate within Agile teams, continuously pursuing domain learning and upskilling opportunities

**Reporting Relationships**

Reports to a Senior Consultant or Manager within IDT. Liaises with onsite/offshore teams to understand functional requirements and may mentor or direct junior team members on a need basis.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Up to 5 years' hands-on experience in software development, with demonstrable competence in full-stack engineering (front-end, back-end, RESTful APIs)
* Experience on agent-based architectures, distributed or agent frameworks, and memory/state management concepts
* Understanding of MCP server architecture and A2A communication principles
* Experience with orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI) and GenAI paradigms (Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)/Context Augmented Generation (CAG))
* Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and DevOps tools (e.g., Git, Jira, Artifactory)
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and team collaboration skills
* Commitment to continuous learning and pursuing emerging technologies
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely aligned technical discipline (B.E., B.Tech, M.C.A., M.Sc.)

**Preferred**

* Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or productizing GenAI, LLM, or agent-driven platforms in business or research settings
* Strong familiarity with microservice architectures and robust event-driven systems
* Awareness of cutting-edge developments in GenAI and multi-agent technologies
* Experience with productivity accelerators (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude code, AWS CodeWhisperer, Cursor AI)

**Core Competencies**

* Full-stack engineering craft across front-end, back-end, and REST APIs
* Growing expertise in agent architectures and orchestration frameworks
* Collaborative team player within Agile pods
* Commitment to continuous learning of emerging GenAI technologies
* Clear communicator and problem solver
* Cloud and DevOps tooling fluency

**Why This Role Matters**

Agentic AI is becoming the operating layer for how enterprises get work done, and this role turns that shift into working systems — building and operationalizing the agent-based modules, RAG/CAG integrations, and orchestration frameworks that let IDT bring breakthrough, IP-based products to market.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. description:
**Machine Learning / Data Scientist, Consultant**

**Deloitte Consulting LLP | IDT**

**About the Role**

At Deloitte Consulting LLP, Data Scientists and ML Engineers leverage advanced analytics and machine learning to transform data into actionable business insights and innovative solutions. Our teams foster technical excellence, real-world impact, and professional growth for every team member. This is a Consultant-level role based out of Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Kolkata, Chennai, or Pune.

IDT anticipates how technology will shape the future and begins building future capabilities and practices today, driving the ideation, incubation, and scale of hybrid businesses and tech-enabled offerings. * Experience working on projects within cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) is preferred
* Strong analytical, teamwork, and communication skills
* B.E./B.Tech./M.C.A./M.Sc./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline

**Preferred**

* Experience with large-scale data processing platforms (PySpark, Dask, BigQuery, Databricks)
* Advanced cloud-based data tool knowledge and ML deployment skills
* Familiarity with productivity tools like GitHub Copilot or AWS CodeWhisperer
* Understanding of industry trends in ML, AI, and MLOps

**Core Competencies**

* Strong ML engineering and experimentation craft (Python, MLflow)
* Ability to translate ML solutions into production-ready APIs
* Cloud-native deployment and automation mindset
* Clear communicator of complex analytical insights
* Mentor and promoter of engineering/MLOps best practices
* Curious and current on AI/ML advancements

A machine learning model only creates value once it's built well, shipped reliably, and trusted by the business that uses it. This role owns that full journey — turning data into actionable insight, and insight into production-grade solutions clients can build decisions on.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**About CITI**

Citi's mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We have 200 years of experience helping our clients meet the world's toughest challenges and embrace its greatest opportunities.

**Citi Analytics and Information Management (AIM)**

Citi AIM was established in 2003 and is located across multiple cities in India - Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram and Pune. It is a global community that objectively connects and analyzes information, to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. It identifies fact-based opportunities for revenue growth in partnership with the businesses. The function balances customer needs, business strategy, and profit objectives using best in class and relevant analytic methodologies.

**What we do?**

The US Consumer Cards (USCC) – Digital Product Analytics Team is a specialized function dedicated to understanding, measuring, and improving the servicing and marketing experience across all digital platforms. We are a dynamic and data-driven team focused on accelerating digital growth, enhancing customer engagement, and driving operational efficiency. By leveraging cutting-edge analytics and Gen-AI, we identify and act on opportunities to improve the customer lifecycle, increase digital revenue, and reduce service costs. We foster a culture of continuous learning and rapid experimentation to deliver impactful digital experiences that resonate with our customers. Our mission is to leverage data and insights to make our digital platforms the preferred channels for our customers, ultimately driving revenue and efficiency.

**Role Description:**

The Spec Analytics Intmd Analyst is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

**Few notables among the multiple areas that we work in:**

* **Drive Digital Marketing, Product Sales & Engagement:**
  + Develop and execute sophisticated digital marketing strategies to significantly grow digital product sales and increase customer footfall and stickiness on our platforms.
  + Analyze user behavior and campaign performance to identify new opportunities for engagement and revenue generation.
* **Optimizing Digital Servicing Channels (Website & Mobile App):**
  + Conduct deep-dive analyses of our website and mobile app to identify and eliminate points of friction in the customer service journey, making them more intuitive, efficient, and user-friendly.
  + Analyze customer interaction data to find opportunities to streamline the digital experience, reducing the need for customers to resort to calls or chats.
* **Leverage Advanced Analytics and AI:**
  + Apply Gen-AI powered analysis to agent calls and the customer's digital journey to enhance and personalize the customer experience.
  + Enhance Chatbot performance for more effective automated customer interactions.
  + Design, develop, and implement advanced GenAI solutions using techniques such as prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI models with frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph.
  + Use analytical intelligence to uncover deep insights that inform strategies for reducing our cost-to-serve and improving overall efficiency across the customer lifecycle.
* **Fostering a Culture of Experimentation:**
  + Lead the industrialization and enhancement of our "Test & Learn" capability, enabling the rapid design, execution, and measurement of experiments for new digital features and marketing campaigns.
  + Utilize A/B testing, multivariate testing, and other experimentation techniques to generate actionable insights and drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Interpret complex data sets to identify significant trends, patterns, and anomalies, translating these into clear, concise, and impactful insights that support informed decision-making for business partners and senior leadership.
* Identifies and compiles data sets using a variety of tools (e.g. SQL, Python, PySpark) to help predict, improve, and measure the success of key business to business outcomes.
* Utilize statistical methods and analytical tools to extract meaningful insights from large and complex datasets.
* Responsible for documenting data requirements, data collection / processing / cleaning, and exploratory data analysis, which may include utilizing statistical models / algorithms and data visualization techniques.
* Incumbents in this role may often be referred to as Data Scientists.

**Technical Skills:**

* Hands-on Experience in Python, SQL & Machine Learning (ML) is a must. Experience with PySpark is preferred.
* Proficiency in GenAI technologies including prompt engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, and the development of Agentic AI.
* Familiarity with GenAI governance principles and best practices to ensure responsible and compliant AI development.
* Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code according to design specifications and coding standards.
* Knowledge of digital marketing and Credit Card business, and industry best practices is highly beneficial.
* Experience working and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to guide and mentor the junior team members. Ability to build partnerships with cross-functional teams.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree with at least 5 years of working experience OR Master's Degree with 4 years of working experience.
* Ability to identify, clearly articulate and solve complex business problems and present them to the management in a structured and simpler form.
* Hands-on experience working with large, complex, unstructured dataset, data warehouses and ability to pull data using relevant programs and coding.
* Experience in working on Investment Analytics, Retail Analytics, Credit Cards, Services, Banking & Markets Financial Services be nice to have.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, be organized, detail oriented, flexible, and adaptive to matrix work environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in Python, PySpark, Hive, Impala, SQL programing will be preferred.
* Credit card Business and P&L experience would be preferred.
* Knowledge on Adobe, Test & Learn and other web analytics tool.

title: Senior Engineer, IAM with designing and architecturing AI/ML systems
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
